jobs.description: In the Department of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology in the Group of Electronic Measurement and Signal Processing at the Technische Universität Ilmenau (Germany) is a vacancy for aResearch assistant (f/m/d)as a Hardware Integration Engineer for 6G Research Platformsas soon as possible.How do groundbreaking wireless ideas become real-world prototypes? Every new communication technology begins as a concept. Turning that concept into a working prototype requires engineers who can integrate cutting-edge hardware, connect complex measurement systems, and transform individual components into a reliable research platform.Our research group develops advanced prototypes for 6G communications, Integrated Communications and Sensing (ISAC), localization, and wireless channel measurements.
